title: rand.hist

messages.description: sets new histogram and clears memory

flags.name: -eq <float>
flags.description: sets equal number of occurrences for all indexes (default 0)

methods.description: a float sets seed, no float sets a unique internal
restart the unrepeat series (keeps the histogram)
set index and increase occurrence by 1
set index and decrease occurrence by 1
clears the memory and sets a new 'n' size
sets an equal number of occurrences for all elements

body: [rand.hist] generates weighted random numbers based on a histogram, which specifies how many times an index is output: with 3 2 5, index 0 has a 30% chance of occurring, 1 has 20% and 2 has 50%. A list sets a new histogram. In "unrepeat" mode, a random sequence is output without repetition, where 3 2 gives index 0 three times and index 1 twice. When the sequence is finished, a bang comes out the right outlet, and the 'restart' message clears the memory so you can start a new sequence.
